title: UAP data withheld to protect classified sensor capabilities
summary: Eric Hazeline tells of UAP data withheld to protect classified sensor capabilities, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and reads it from an official document. As told, not a fact.

plain: Eric Hazeline, described as a former director of the NSA, the US agency that gathers intelligence from communications and signals, says he has no doubt about one reason UFO material stays secret. According to him, some of it was captured by collection systems, meaning spy sensors, that the government does not want anyone to know it has, so the data is held back to protect the sensors rather than to hide the objects.
